limits: Local mock transport only; not real DVN, Executor, finality, Safe, or globally unique genesis validation. Both bridge fixtures are deployed on one local chain ID. Explicit mock seed is used on chain 1. Endpoint inject deliberately models trusted-message compromise.
residualRisk: Trusted peer / fixed Endpoint can create authenticated-looking credit without source burn; not fixed by removing direct mint.
